name: LMFBR Benchmark Problem 4
description: Provides standardized neutronics and burnup test cases for validation and inter-comparison of reactor physics codes for a large heterogeneous fast reactor.
evaluation_method: comparison to reference solutions using numerical error metrics (absolute/relative error on keff, flux, burnup, power distributions)
general_score_metric: absolute/relative error against reference neutronics/burnup values (e.g., keff error, flux distribution error)
reputation: Well-known within reactor-physics and fast-reactor communities as a standard validation/intercomparison suite for neutronics and burnup codes.
notes: Non-LLM, domain-specific benchmark requiring specialized codes and expertise; limited to neutronics/burnup validation for fast reactor configurations.
